sentence: Clicking an HTML anchor link that points to a spot inside the same tiddler keeps that tiddler on screen and does not open another tiddler.
setup: In the sidebar on the right side of the page, click the plus icon button (its tooltip says 'Create a new tiddler'). An edit form opens with a title box that says 'New Tiddler'. Leave the title as it is. Click inside the large empty text area below the title and tags and type exactly this on one line, keeping both # characters in a row in the href and the single # in the id: Jump to spot Landing place Then click the tick (checkmark) button at the top right of that edit form (its tooltip says 'Confirm changes to this tiddler'). Scroll to the tiddler titled 'New Tiddler' if it is not in view. Do not click the link 'Jump to spot' yet.
ready: A tiddler titled 'New Tiddler' is shown with the link 'Jump to spot' and the text 'Landing place' in its body.
action: In the body of the tiddler titled 'New Tiddler', click the link 'Jump to spot' once. Wait 2 seconds. Do not scroll or click anything else.
broken: A separate tiddler whose title contains 'my-spot' (such as '#my-spot') is shown in the main area, with a message that this tiddler is missing.
working: The text 'Landing place' is shown in the main area, and no tiddler whose title contains 'my-spot' and no missing tiddler message is shown.
